name: PlayStation Portable (PSP)
significance: The first portable console to mount a serious commercial challenge against Nintendo's handheld supremacy, selling over 80 million units worldwide.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 32 MB main RAM (64 MB in PSP-2000/3000), 4 MB eDRAM

editorialContent.overview: Sony's gorgeous wide-aspect handheld delivering console-fidelity 3D graphics and multimedia playback on a 4.3-inch TFT LCD.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: The first portable console to mount a serious commercial challenge against Nintendo's handheld supremacy, selling over 80 million units worldwide.
editorialContent.controllerDesign: D-pad, 4 action buttons, analog sliding nub, L/R triggers
